2␟Overwintering: The shift from sailing home to Scandinavia each autumn to instead seizing a defensible river island or coastal fort and digging in for the winter, so a Viking fleet could raid from a fixed local base all year round.
3␟Whitby: A town on the Yorkshire coast of England whose name ends in the Norse word -by ("village" or "farm"); its name is a lingering fingerprint of the Danelaw, the region Viking settlers controlled and renamed.
